description: This file contains the implementation of the ClientService interface, providing methods for managing Client entities, including CRUD operations, retrieving status lists, and associating clients with users within a Spring application.

classes.name: ClientServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ClientService interface, providing business logic for client management.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Client by its ID.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Client by its name, ignoring case.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all Clients.

methods.name: getStatusList
methods.description: Provides a list of client status strings.

methods.name: saveClientWithLoggedUser
methods.description: Saves a Client associated with the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: saveClient
methods.description: Saves a Client without associating a user.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes a Client by its ID.

methods.name: findByUser
methods.description: Finds all Clients associated with a specific User.
